title: Slavin Nadal School of Ballet
specs: Curriculum with traditional Russian roots: Ballet Russe and Vaganova method
Emphasis on épaulement from earliest years
Incorporates French, English, and Danish schools
blurb: The school offers ballet training reflecting the Ballet Russe and Vaganova method, emphasizing épaulement and incorporating elements from French, English, and Danish schools. The curriculum aims to produce dancers with refined and versatile technique. The school is directed by Joseph Nygren Cox and Kimberly Nygren Cox, both experienced professionals with extensive backgrounds in ballet performance and teaching.
